title: A Cover for the Border Revisited
author: August Vane
blurb: Elodie Lockridge, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
